description: Risk-neutral probabilities implied by crypto options (Deribit) at one expiry: chance of settling above/below a price or inside a range, expected 68%/90% ranges, lognormal at that expiry's ATM IV and forward plus a smile-adjusted value within quoted strikes. Market-implied odds, not calibrated forecasts.
name: options_probability

atmIvPct.description: ATM implied volatility of that expiry, percent annualized (calculated; not DVOL)

between.description: Odds of settling inside the requested range; absent when no range was requested

days.description: Days from the snapshot to that expiry

expiry.description: The expiry used, ISO 8601 UTC (08:00 UTC settlement); absent when the venue lists no options

forwardUsd.description: Forward price the venue priced that expiry off, USD

meta.description: Provenance of the snapshot the numbers come from

ageSeconds.description: Seconds between the observation and this response

observedAt.description: When the venue snapshot was observed, ISO 8601 UTC

prices.description: Odds of settling above or below each price: the requested price, or a ladder of ±1σ and ±2σ of that expiry when none was given; empty when a range was requested

aboveLognormal.description: P(settle above), 0–1, lognormal at ATM IV

aboveSmileAdjusted.description: P(settle above) adjusted for the smile; absent outside the quoted strikes

quantiles.description: Risk-neutral lognormal quantiles of the settlement price

cumulative.description: Cumulative probability, 0–1 (0.16/0.84 bound the 68% range, 0.05/0.95 the 90% range)

quotedStrikeRange.description: Strikes inside which the smile-adjusted values are available

title: Options Expiry Probabilities
